cardEffects:
[On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
◼This card can be used as a [Familiar] token.
◼Tokens can't be put in decks or Digi-Egg decks.
◼Cards can't be stacked with tokens. (They can't digivolve or have cards placed under them by an effect)
◼Tokens can't get linked.
◼ When a Token is removed from the field, it is removed from the game instead of being placed in another area.
name: Familiar
